text:
Sam: Quick design review request — batch Vectors preview toolbar. Mainly copy + keyboard nav + export behavior. Screenshot uploaded.
Lina: Thanks — high level: toolbar feels cramped. Copy 'Export' is ambiguous. Suggest 'Download vectors (CSV)'. Also prefer header 'Vector preview' (singular) — reads clearer when viewing one row.
Rory: +1 on 'Download vectors (CSV)'. Backend note: exports can be async for large files; plan to return a job id and let client poll or email if >10k rows.
Rory: Also the service currently truncates floats to 6 decimals; for UI display we should round to 3 decimals, but keep full precision in the exported CSV.
Marta: A11y nits: export button needs explicit aria-label 'Download vectors as CSV'. Keyboard: ensure left/right arrow moves between toolbar items and Up/Down focuses rows. Add a live region announce: 'Export started' and 'Export ready'.
Sean: UX nit on relevance column. Product prefers 'Relevance (0–1)' rather than 'Score'. Suggest default display to 3 decimals and a hover to show full precision. Consider a percent toggle in column settings.
Lina: Batch input placeholder currently: 'Paste texts or CSV'. Make it more actionable: 'Paste text lines or upload CSV (column named "text" or "query"). Need help formatting? See docs.'
Sam: For buttons let's pick final copy: primary 'Download CSV' and secondary 'Export selection'. Tooltip: 'Download selected vectors as CSV. Columns: id, text, vector_768, relevance_score'.
Rory: For the vector cell we should show collapsed arrays by default: '[-0.003, 0.124, ...]'. Click expands to full array in a monospace panel. Header should read 'Vector (dim 768)'.
Marta: When collapsed preview is interactive, mark the collapsed span aria-hidden and provide an 'Expand vector' button with aria-expanded state. Also double-check toolbar icon contrast on dark theme — current contrast is ~3.8:1.
Lina: I'll update the mock and push a new frame later today. Quick decisions agreed: copy -> 'Download CSV', header -> 'Vector preview', relevance -> 'Relevance (0–1)', placeholder -> 'Paste text lines or upload CSV (column: text)'.
ux-bot: file uploaded: batch_vpreview_v2.png
